title: True Blue Account: Wire Transfers and Free Wires
summary: This document covers the True Blue Account’s wire transfer fee structure: 10 free outgoing domestic wires and 15 free incoming domestic wires per month. After free wires are used, additional domestic wires cost $5.00 per transfer. It also explains how canceled/returned wires don’t restore free wires and how to avoid unexpected charges.
